title: Upgraded Iron Chests with Search and Transfer
description: Upgradable storage chests from Iron to Netherite. Features single/double sizes, quick-stack inventory buttons, and a global item search that tracks and highlights which linked chest contains your items.
body:
![banner](https://github.com/in2bubble/Upgraded-Chests-Search-Quick-Transfer-Midea/blob/main/Midea/ph.png?raw=true)
![upgraded iron chests](https://github.com/in2bubble/Upgraded-Chests-Search-Quick-Transfer-Midea/blob/main/Midea/p1.png?raw=true)

Upgraded Iron Chests adds Iron, Gold, Diamond, and Netherite chests in single and double sizes to expand storage capacity. It features an in-GUI search bar, quick-transfer options, and inventory buttons to dump or quick-stack items into nearby chests. The mod also includes a chest-linking system with world path highlighting and an interface toggle to disable chest particles locally.

![Media](https://github.com/in2bubble/Upgraded-Chests-Search-Quick-Transfer-Midea/blob/main/Midea/p3.png?raw=true)

![gif1](https://github.com/in2bubble/Upgraded-Chests-Search-Quick-Transfer-Midea/blob/main/Midea/Animation-1.gif?raw=true)
![gif2](https://github.com/in2bubble/Upgraded-Chests-Search-Quick-Transfer-Midea/blob/main/Midea/Animation-2.gif?raw=true)
![gif3](https://github.com/in2bubble/Upgraded-Chests-Search-Quick-Transfer-Midea/blob/main/Midea/Animation-3.gif?raw=true)
![items](https://github.com/in2bubble/Upgraded-Chests-Search-Quick-Transfer-Midea/blob/main/Midea/items.png?raw=true)

![Key Features](https://github.com/in2bubble/Upgraded-Chests-Search-Quick-Transfer-Midea/blob/main/Midea/p-2.png?raw=true)

- **Multi-Tier Storage Chests**: Adds Iron, Gold, Diamond, and Netherite chests supporting both single and double block configurations.

- **Built-in Search Bar**: An integrated search text box within the chest GUI to filter and locate specific items and resources quickly.

- **Quick-Transfer Interface**: Dedicated buttons (Withdraw / Deposit) to move full inventories between the player and the chest with a single click.

- **Player Inventory Buttons**: Adds utility buttons directly to the vanilla inventory screen: "Quick Stack" (transfers items only into nearby chests that already contain matching items) and "Deposit All / Dump" (empties your inventory items into nearby chests).

- **Chest Linking & Highlighting**: A system to link chests together, paired with a tool that renders visual lines in the world to show the exact location of the linked chest.

- **Particle Controls**: Custom ambient particles render around upgraded chests, with a dedicated toggle switch in the player inventory screen to enable or disable these effects locally.

- **Fireproof Construction**: Every chest in this mod is completely immune to fire and lava, ensuring your loot is never lost to an accident.

- **Netherite Blast Immunity**: The Netherite Tier is 100% explosion-proof (TNT & Creepers), providing the ultimate security for your most valuable items.

![Platform Compatibility](https://github.com/in2bubble/Upgraded-Chests-Search-Quick-Transfer-Midea/blob/main/Midea/p4.png?raw=true)

- **Supported Loaders**: This mod is now fully compatible with **Fabric**, **Forge**, and **NeoForge**.

- **Upcoming Versions**: Over time, support will be added for other Minecraft versions such as **1.21** and **1.20**.

- **Server Support**: Optimized for both Singleplayer and Multiplayer. You can run this mod on dedicated servers using any of the supported loaders for a seamless experience.

- **Community & Ideas**: Have suggestions for new features or general questions? Share your thoughts in the [CurseForge Comments Section](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/upgraded-iron-chests/comments).
